dependency_rules.AUDITED: Must carry a PASS audit receipt and may depend only on AUDITED or DECLARED_GOAL claims. A DECLARED_GOAL dependency is structural/contextual and cannot supply mathematical proof credit.
dependency_rules.DECLARED_GOAL: Defines target/contract only and grants no mathematical credit.
dependency_rules.PROVISIONAL: May depend on AUDITED, PROVISIONAL, or DECLARED_GOAL; never grants audited credit.
dependency_rules.SCRATCH: May depend on any non-REVOKED claim, but no non-SCRATCH claim may depend on SCRATCH.
dependency_rules.SUPERSEDED: Retained for provenance; cannot satisfy FINAL-CHECK.
